values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, $17 a night, taxes included; paid the same day before occupying a site.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-parks/fees.html ('In state forests (taxes are included): Drive-in campsites $17/night') + https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Fees include taxes.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Individual sites take no reservations: pay online on the arrival date ('you may not pay ahead for camping on a future date') or at a state park ranger station, then take an unoccupied site. The 14-day limit runs from the first Saturday in May to the second Sunday in September; 21 days the rest of the year.

booking.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/camping.html ('Individual campsites do not accept reservations; they are available by same day advance payment'; 'limited to a total of 14 days in any one forest campground between the first Saturday in May through the second Sunday in September, or 21 days the rest of the year') + fees-reservations.html ('Same day advance payment is available on your arrival date, you may not pay ahead'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: DNR Bowstring State Forest data, Moose Lake Campground ('camping': {'campsites': 11}) and facility map cmp00049.pdf (sites 1-11), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: DNR Bowstring State Forest data, Moose Lake Campground ('vault toilets, garbage cans, and hand-pump for drinking water') + state-forests/camping.html ('State forest campgrounds do not have dump stations'; no 'modern facilities such as showers and flush toilets'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/camping.html ('there are no utilities such as electricity or sewer available at the campsites; only rustic camping is available'), read 2026-11-11

note: Bowstring State Forest campground (just outside the forest boundary) near Deer River, on a wooded loop a short walk from Moose Lake and its boat launch. Single tight loop with shallow gravel pads, best for shorter rigs; a 23-ft rig fits some sites but big rigs won't. --Claude
summary: DNR forest data, facility map and fee/camping pages read: $17 a night tax included (confirmed), FCFS with same-day online payment, 14-day summer limit, 11 sites, vault toilets + hand pump, no hookups, no dump (all now manual). Not waterfront confirmed (sites 60-150 m from the lake through forest). Website to hyphen form; add phone 218-328-8982.
flags: Phone missing: add 218-328-8982 (DNR 'Parks and Trails Grand Rapids area office', the manager the DNR forest data names for Moose Lake Campground).

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. The facility map puts sites 1-6 on the west arm of the loop, the nearest ~60-70 m from Moose Lake on imagery through continuous forest and a marsh fringe; the lake access is the trailer launch at the end of the entry road.
Season: the DNR says forest campgrounds 'are open seasonally' with dates that 'vary by campground'; no dates published for Moose Lake. Season left absent.
No current alert on the Bowstring State Forest record (alert general null, no forest-road or OHV alerts). Pin 47.39398,-93.67222 is in the middle of the loop; no move.
